page_title: MON 0-0 DAR | B. Monchengladbach v Darmstadt 10/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee awards a corner and Patrick Herrmann (B. Monchengladbach) goes over to take it.
90+3' Patrick Herrmann (B. Monchengladbach) takes the free kick which is dealt with by the opposition defence.
90+2' Sascha Stegemann shows a yellow card to Matej Maglica (Darmstadt) for his blatant foul.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
89' The players claim that Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) handled the ball inside the box and it seems they are right.
89' The referee blows his whistle, B. Monchengladbach are awarded a corner kick.
87' Patrick Herrmann (B. Monchengladbach) is about to take a corner kick.
86' B. Monchengladbach hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
82' Andreas Muller (Darmstadt) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Sascha Stegemann had an easy-decision to make.
81' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar.
79' Torsten Lieberknecht decides to make a substitution. Matthias Bader will be replaced by Fabian Nurnberger (Darmstadt).
77' Ball possession – 59:41.
75' Marcel Schuhen (Darmstadt) is booked by the referee.
72' Florian Neuhaus will be replaced by Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach).
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Franck Honorat leaves the pitch and Patrick Herrmann (B. Monchengladbach) comes on.
72' Here is a change. Maximilian Wober is going off and Gerardo Seoane gives the last tactical orders to Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach).
70' Matthias Bader (Darmstadt) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from the edge of the box, but it goes just wide of the left post.
69' Some great controlled play and passing from Darmstadt. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
67' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Julian Justvan (Darmstadt) comes onto the pitch so that Marvin Mehlem can be given a rest.
67' Torsten Lieberknecht prepares a substitution. Sebastian Polter is replaced by Oscar Vilhelmsson (Darmstadt).
67' Here comes a substitution. Jannik Muller (Darmstadt) is brought on as a substitute for Christoph Zimmermann.
65' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) was quite harsh and Sascha Stegemann didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
64' Marcel Schuhen makes a brilliant save! Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) met a rebound outside the box and attempted to beat the keeper low into the middle of the goal.
64' The attendance for today's match is 42000.
63' Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
61' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Darmstadt was in an offside position.
59' The corner is swung in but B. Monchengladbach can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
58' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Robin Hack.
58' Christoph Zimmermann (Darmstadt) has tested the patience of referee Sascha Stegemann and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
57' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) picks up an injury.
55' Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
52' Darmstadt have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
51' Darmstadt can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
49' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
45+20' The match has reached half-time.
45+16' Jordan Siebatcheu (B. Monchengladbach) is substituted due to injury. Gerardo Seoane gives a chance to Alassane Plea.
45+12' A player from Darmstadt brings down an opponent and commits a foul.
45+8' B. Monchengladbach are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
45+4' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 6:4.
45+1' The resulting set piece from B. Monchengladbach is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
45' 16 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Everything seems to be alright after the game was interrupted, the referee blows his whistle and the match can continue.
32' The match will be interrupted for a while due to some disturbances.
30' Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach) makes a rough challenge and Sascha Stegemann blows his whistle for a foul.
29' A spell of possession for Darmstadt in an attempt to control the game.
25' A short pass finds Emir Karic (Darmstadt) in acres of space on the edge of the box and he decides to go for glory. His efforts looks in for all the world but just creeps past the left post.

25' Manu Kone (B. Monchengladbach) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
23' Matthias Bader (Darmstadt) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
19' Some neat passing and movement from B. Monchengladbach as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
16' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) takes a short pass in his stride inside the box, but hits a poor shot at goal that goes well wide of the right post.
12' Torsten Lieberknecht is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Bartol Franjic suffers an injury and Andreas Muller (Darmstadt) comes on.

9' Jordan Siebatcheu (B. Monchengladbach) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
5' B. Monchengladbach string together a series of short passes.
3' Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Sascha Stegemann saw the whole situation.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Darmstadt will have the kick-off.
Sascha Stegemann will officiate today.
